entries.title: To Paul Graham
entries.author: Ixiaus
entries.excerpt: I recently read a short blog article talking about the doom of Digg and the final paragraph caught my eye: But Digg is in a deadly, unrecoverable tail spin. The fact is, people -- real people -- are beginning to tire. Submit this, upload that, vote on this, "like" that, be my "friend", check in here, suggest this, retweet that ... there's already so much to do. The only thing left to "Digg" is a grave. It is, precisely, the simplicity and minimalism of Hacker News' feature se
entries.guide_zh: 一位读者致信 Paul Graham，表达对 HN 简洁设计的看法。

entries.title: Ask HN: How to become a millionaire in 3 years?
entries.author: babyboy808
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How to become a millionaire in 3 years?
entries.excerpt: As everyone else on the planet I'm sure, I would like to become a millionaire and within a tight time constraint: 3 short years. HN is a constant source of excellent articles, amazing intelligent advice and smart people, so how would you go about it? Saving, Stocks etc etc? entries.excerpt: I don't own a Macbook, but when people ask me what they should get it's hard to recommend a good alternative. entries.title: Last week Apple asked me to remove my app from the App Store. Now I know why.
entries.author: bcwood

entries.title: Ask HN: How can I get better at design?
entries.author: nudge
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How can I get better at design?
entries.excerpt: While for larger projects it makes most sense to partner with a designer, I would like to be able to make my own hobby projects/sites look a bit better (http://vowsjs.org/ is a fantastic example - I wouldn't even know where to begin). The problem is, I'm not terribly artistic. I understand HTML/CSS fine, and I can tell what (I think) looks good, but I wouldn't have a clue how to do it myself. Is this something I can improve at, and if so, how? Thanks.
entries.guide_zh: 业余项目也想做得好看，程序员该如何提升基本视觉设计能力？
